sources.title: Mel Kiper’s latest 2026 NFL mock draft takes a surprising turn
sources.description: The NFL Draft is next week. As we close in on the main event, ESPN’s Mel Kiper has posted a new mock draft. Kiper has the Jets making a consensus choice second overall but moves in an unexpected direction with pick 16. I get the sense the Jets will take production over potential here in […]
